action: Implement in scripts/emit-audit-signal.sh: collapse _ledger_prune_and_lookup()+_ledger_upsert()'s two independent bare-tmp+mv writes into one CAS-guarded write (_ledger_apply(), mtime-before/after retry loop mirroring this file's own existing _e3_write_row() idiom, right-sized — no orch-apply.sh/Zod/conservation machinery needed). Use jq -c uniformly at the single remaining write site (kills the pretty/compact format flip). Add 4 tests to scripts/emit-audit-signal.test.sh per brief §3, especially T-LEDGER-CONCURRENT-WRITERS (2 real parallel invocations against a shared scratch ledger fixture — positive control for the exact clobber this fixes; none of the current 26+ tests exercise this). Route to developer if this exceeds direct-edit comfort zone (script logic).
summary: docs/data/auditor-dedup-ledger.json has silently dropped previously-committed keys on 2 session-separated occasions (2026-08-05 c30, 2026-08-12 post-c50 — meets the 2-instance escalation threshold in feedback_auditor_dedup_ledger_key_dropped_and_format_reverted.md). Root-caused by reading scripts/emit-audit-signal.sh directly: _ledger_write() is a bare tmp+mv with zero CAS-guard, and one invocation performs 2 independent read-modify-write cycles (_ledger_prune_and_lookup() always writes, _ledger_upsert() conditionally writes again) — a lost-update race when concurrent system-auditor sessions/tiers invoke this script around the same window (confirmed-live peer-session pattern already exists at docs/agents/system-auditor/flow/main.md:262). RAW-diffed working tree vs last commit (71dc2af9c) myself: 3 specific keys confirmed dropped (db_integrity_breach:daily_ohlcv:OHLCV_H_L_ZERO, mem_pressure:mcp-server:A-30, microservice_degraded:mcp-server:A-21), matching the dispatch report exactly. The pretty/compact format flip is a SEPARATE same-script bug, not a second-writer signal: _ledger_prune_and_lookup() writes with jq -c (compact) while _ledger_upsert() writes with plain jq (pretty default) — whichever ran last wins, explaining the flip in both directions without needing 2 writer scripts. Fix: collapse to 1 CAS-guarded write per invocation, reusing this same file's own proven E-3/orch-state CAS-retry shape at a right-sized scope (no Zod/conservation needed for a flat 2-field map). Did NOT hand-patch docs/data/auditor-dedup-ledger.json — left as evidence per dispatch instruction.
